final: WITH country_counts AS (SELECT c.country, COUNT(*) AS country_count FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.country), total_counts AS (SELECT SUM(country_count) AS total_count FROM country_counts), paired AS (SELECT cc.country, cc.country_count, 1.0 * cc.country_count / tc.total_count AS country_ratio FROM country_counts AS cc JOIN total_counts AS tc ON tc.total_count IS NOT NULL), average_counts AS (SELECT AVG(country_count) AS average_count FROM paired) SELECT AVG(p.country_count), AVG(p.country_ratio), AVG(p.country_count - a.average_count) FROM paired AS p JOIN average_counts AS a ON a.average_count IS NOT NULL WHERE p.country_count > a.average_count
